mapper.insert: INSERT DEL_LOG( DEL_DATE, SESSION_NAME, ORD_DATE, DEL_KIND, CORP_NAME, PROD_NAME, PROD_NO, PROD_GYU, DEL_SU, DEL_AMNT, ORD_LOT ) SELECT CONVERT(CHAR(10), GETDATE(), 23), #{user_name}, ORDERT.ORD_INPUT, '작업지시', CORP.CORP_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NAME, PRODUCT.PROD_NO, PRODUCT.PROD_GYU, WORKILBO.ILBO_SU, WORKILBO.ILBO_JUNG, ORDERT.ORD_LOT FROM WORKILBO INNER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE INNER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE INNER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND WORKILBO.ILBO_CODE = #{ilbo_code} AND WORKILBO.ILBO_GUBN = #{ilbo_gubn} AND WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = #{ord_code}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM WORKILBO WHERE ilbo_code = #{ilbo_code} AND ilbo_gubn = #{ilbo_gubn} AND ord_code = #{ord_code}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM USERT WHERE user_ret = '0'

SELECT *, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ILBO_STRT,120) AS ilbo_strt_date, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ', PROD_PG2) AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CONCAT('J',FORMAT(ILBO_CODE,'000000000')) AS danch_barcode, FORMAT(WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT,'HH:mm') AS ilbo_strt_time, FORMAT(WORKILBO.ILBO_END,'HH:mm') AS ilbo_end_time, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_STRT,120) AS ilbo_strt, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_END,120) AS ilbo_end, CONCAT(prod_si,' ', prod_si1,' ~ ',prod_si2) AS prod_si, CONCAT(prod_sr,' ', prod_sr1,' ~ ',prod_sr2) AS prod_sr FROM WORKILBO LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN FACILITY ON WORKILBO.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND WORKILBO.ILBO_GUBN = 'J'
AND WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59')
AND CORP.CORP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{corp_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.PROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.PROD_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_no},'%')
ORDER BY ILBO_CODE

SELECT *, (ORD_SU - ISNULL(danch_su,0)) AS danch_remain_su, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ', PROD_PG2) AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CASE WHEN WSTD_T43 IS NULL THEN '0' ELSE WSTD_T43 END AS wstd_t43, ISNULL(product_file_name,'no_image.png') AS product_file_name, ISNULL(wstd_chim_file_name1,'no_image.png') AS wstd_chim_file_name1, CONCAT(prod_si,' ', prod_si1,' ~ ',prod_si2) AS prod_si, CONCAT(prod_sr,' ', prod_sr1,' ~ ',prod_sr2) AS prod_sr FROM ORDERT A LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT ord_code, SUM(ilbo_su) AS danch_su FROM WORKILBO WHERE ilbo_gubn = 'J' GROUP BY ord_code ) B ON A.ord_code = B.ord_code LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT C ON A.prod_code = C.prod_code LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP D ON C.corp_code = D.corp_code LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PROD_CODE, MAX(REPLACE((CASE WHEN WSTD_T43 IS NULL OR WSTD_T43 = '' THEN '0' ELSE WSTD_T43 END),',','')) AS WSTD_T43, MAX(wstd_t32) AS WSTD_T32, MAX(wstd_t33) AS WSTD_T33, MAX(wstd_t41) AS WSTD_T41, MAX(wstd_t87) AS WSTD_T87, MAX(wstd_t44) AS WSTD_T44, MAX(wstd_t51) AS WSTD_T51, MAX(wstd_t52) AS WSTD_T52, MAX(wstd_t53) AS WSTD_T53, MAX(wstd_t54) AS WSTD_T54, MAX(wstd_t30) AS WSTD_T30, MAX(wstd_chim_file_name1) AS WSTD_CHIM_FILE_NAME1 FROM WORKSTD GROUP BY PROD_CODE ) E ON C.prod_code = E.prod_code WHERE (A.ord_su > B.danch_su OR B.danch_su IS NULL) AND A.ord_input >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND A.ord_input <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 00:00:00')
AND D.corp_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{corp_name},'%')
AND C.prod_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_name},'%')
AND C.prod_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_no},'%')
AND A.ord_code = #{ord_code}
AND A.ord_code NOT IN
#{ord_code}
ORDER BY A.ord_code
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(ILBO_CODE),0)+1 FROM WORKILBO

SELECT *, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ILBO_STRT,120) AS ilbo_strt_date, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ', PROD_PG2) AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CONCAT('J',FORMAT(ILBO_PC,'000000000')) AS danch_barcode, FORMAT(WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT,'HH:mm') AS ilbo_strt_time, FORMAT(WORKILBO.ILBO_END,'HH:mm') AS ilbo_end_time, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_STRT,120) AS ilbo_strt, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_END,120) AS ilbo_end, CONCAT(prod_si,' ', prod_si1,' ~ ',prod_si2) AS prod_si, CONCAT(prod_sr,' ', prod_sr1,' ~ ',prod_sr2) AS prod_sr FROM WORKILBO LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN FACILITY ON WORKILBO.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TECHIN ON PRODUCT.TECH_NO = TECHIN.TECH_NO WHERE 1=1 AND ILBO_GUBN = 'A'
AND WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59')
AND CORP.CORP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{corp_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.PROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.PROD_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_no},'%')
AND FACILITY.FAC_CODE = #{fac_code}
ORDER BY ILBO_CODE

SELECT *, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ', PROD_PG2) AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_STRT,120) AS ilbo_strt, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_END,120) AS ilbo_end, dbo.func_prod_spec_msg(prod_si1) AS prod_si1_msg, dbo.func_prod_spec_msg(prod_si2) AS prod_si2_msg, dbo.func_prod_spec_msg(prod_sr1) AS prod_sr1_msg, dbo.func_prod_spec_msg(prod_sr2) AS prod_sr2_msg, CONCAT(prod_si,' ', prod_si1,' ~ ',prod_si2) AS prod_si, CONCAT(prod_sr,' ', prod_sr1,' ~ ',prod_sr2) AS prod_sr FROM WORKILBO LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PROD_CODE, MAX(wstd_gj11) AS WSTD_GJ11, MAX(wstd_gj12) AS WSTD_GJ12, MAX(wstd_gj13) AS WSTD_GJ13, MAX(wstd_gj14) AS WSTD_GJ14, MAX(wstd_gj16) AS WSTD_GJ16, MAX(wstd_gj17) AS WSTD_GJ17, MAX(wstd_gj21) AS WSTD_GJ21, MAX(wstd_gj22) AS WSTD_GJ22, MAX(wstd_gj23) AS WSTD_GJ23, MAX(wstd_gj24) AS WSTD_GJ24, MAX(wstd_gj32) AS WSTD_GJ32, MAX(wstd_gj33) AS WSTD_GJ33, MAX(wstd_gj34) AS WSTD_GJ34, MAX(wstd_gj42) AS WSTD_GJ42 FROM WORKSTD GROUP BY PROD_CODE ) WORKSTD ON PRODUCT.PROD_CODE = WORKSTD.PROD_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND CONCAT('J',FORMAT(ILBO_CODE,'000000000')) = #{danch_barcode}

SELECT CONCAT('TK',RIGHT(REPLACE(#{ilbo_lot_date},'-',''),6),'-',#{fac_code}, (COUNT(*)+1), ( SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '0' WHEN COUNT(*) = 2 THEN 'A' WHEN COUNT(*) = 3 THEN 'B' ELSE 'B' END AS ilbo_lot_count FROM workilbo WHERE 1=1 AND ilbo_code = #{ilbo_code} GROUP BY ilbo_code ) ) FROM ( SELECT ILBO_LOT FROM WORKILBO WHERE 1=1 AND ILBO_STRT >= CONCAT(#{ilbo_lot_date},' 00:00:00') AND FAC_CODE = #{fac_code} AND ILBO_PN = 0 AND ILBO_GUBN = 'A' GROUP BY ILBO_LOT ) A

SELECT dan.*, ORDERT.*, PRODUCT.*, CORP.*, WORKSTD.*, TECHIN.*, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONCAT('J',FORMAT(dan.ILBO_CODE,'000000000')) AS danch_barcode, FORMAT(dan.ILBO_STRT,'HH:mm') AS ilbo_strt_time, FORMAT(dan.ILBO_END,'HH:mm') AS ilbo_end_time, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),dan.ILBO_STRT,120) AS ilbo_strt, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),dan.ILBO_END,120) AS ilbo_end, FORMAT(dan.ilbo_jung,'N2') AS ilbo_jung FROM ( SELECT * FROM workilbo WHERE 1=1 AND ilbo_gubn = 'J' AND ilbo_strt != '1900-01-01 00:00:00' ) AS dan LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT * FROM workilbo WHERE 1=1 AND ilbo_gubn = 'A' ) AS bcf ON dan.ilbo_code = bcf.ilbo_pc LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ON dan.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PROD_CODE, MAX(wstd_gj11) AS WSTD_GJ11, MAX(wstd_gj12) AS WSTD_GJ12, MAX(wstd_gj13) AS WSTD_GJ13, MAX(wstd_gj14) AS WSTD_GJ14, MAX(wstd_gj16) AS WSTD_GJ16, MAX(wstd_gj17) AS WSTD_GJ17, MAX(wstd_gj21) AS WSTD_GJ21, MAX(wstd_gj22) AS WSTD_GJ22, MAX(wstd_gj23) AS WSTD_GJ23, MAX(wstd_gj24) AS WSTD_GJ24, MAX(wstd_gj32) AS WSTD_GJ32, MAX(wstd_gj33) AS WSTD_GJ33, MAX(wstd_gj34) AS WSTD_GJ34, MAX(wstd_gj42) AS WSTD_GJ42 FROM WORKSTD GROUP BY PROD_CODE ) WORKSTD ON PRODUCT.PROD_CODE = WORKSTD.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TECHIN ON PRODUCT.TECH_NO = TECHIN.TECH_NO WHERE 1=1 AND bcf.ilbo_pc IS NULL AND ORDERT.ord_input >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND ORDERT.ord_input <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 00:00:00')
AND CORP.corp_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{corp_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.prod_name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.prod_no LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_no},'%')
AND dan.ilbo_code = #{ilbo_code}
AND dan.ilbo_code NOT IN
#{ilbo_code}
ORDER BY dan.ilbo_code DESC

SELECT *, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ', PROD_PG2) AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_STRT,120) AS ilbo_strt, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_END,120) AS ilbo_end, dbo.func_prod_spec_msg(prod_si1) AS prod_si1_msg, dbo.func_prod_spec_msg(prod_si2) AS prod_si2_msg, dbo.func_prod_spec_msg(prod_sr1) AS prod_sr1_msg, dbo.func_prod_spec_msg(prod_sr2) AS prod_sr2_msg, CONCAT(prod_si,' ', prod_si1,' ~ ',prod_si2) AS prod_si, CONCAT(prod_sr,' ', prod_sr1,' ~ ',prod_sr2) AS prod_sr FROM WORKILBO LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PROD_CODE, MAX(wstd_gj11) AS WSTD_GJ11, MAX(wstd_gj12) AS WSTD_GJ12, MAX(wstd_gj13) AS WSTD_GJ13, MAX(wstd_gj14) AS WSTD_GJ14, MAX(wstd_gj16) AS WSTD_GJ16, MAX(wstd_gj17) AS WSTD_GJ17, MAX(wstd_gj21) AS WSTD_GJ21, MAX(wstd_gj22) AS WSTD_GJ22, MAX(wstd_gj23) AS WSTD_GJ23, MAX(wstd_gj24) AS WSTD_GJ24, MAX(wstd_gj32) AS WSTD_GJ32, MAX(wstd_gj33) AS WSTD_GJ33, MAX(wstd_gj34) AS WSTD_GJ34, MAX(wstd_gj42) AS WSTD_GJ42 FROM WORKSTD GROUP BY PROD_CODE ) WORKSTD ON PRODUCT.PROD_CODE = WORKSTD.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN TECHIN ON PRODUCT.TECH_NO = TECHIN.TECH_NO WHERE 1=1 AND ILBO_CODE = #{ilbo_code}

SELECT *, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ILBO_STRT,120) AS ilbo_strt_date, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ', PROD_PG2) AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CONCAT('J',FORMAT(ILBO_PC,'000000000')) AS danch_barcode, FORMAT(WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT,'HH:mm') AS ilbo_strt_time, FORMAT(WORKILBO.ILBO_END,'HH:mm') AS ilbo_end_time, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_STRT,120) AS ilbo_strt, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_END,120) AS ilbo_end, CONCAT(prod_si,' ', prod_si1,' ~ ',prod_si2) AS prod_si, CONCAT(prod_sr,' ', prod_sr1,' ~ ',prod_sr2) AS prod_sr FROM WORKILBO LEFT OUTER JOIN ORDERT ON WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = ORDERT.ORD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN PRODUCT ON ORDERT.PROD_CODE = PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN FACILITY ON WORKILBO.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE WHERE 1=1 AND ILBO_GUBN = 'R'
AND WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT >= CONCAT(#{sdate},' 00:00:00') AND WORKILBO.ILBO_STRT <= CONCAT(#{edate},' 23:59:59')
AND CORP.CORP_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{corp_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.PROD_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_name},'%')
AND PRODUCT.PROD_NO LIKE CONCAT('%',#{prod_no},'%')
AND WORKILBO.ILBO_CODE = #{ilbo_code}
AND WORKILBO.ORD_CODE = #{ord_code}

SELECT *, CONCAT('J',FORMAT(ILBO_PC,'000000000')) AS danch_barcode, CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),ord_input,120) AS ord_input_view, CONCAT(PROD_PG,' ',PROD_PG1,' ~ ', PROD_PG2) AS prod_pg, CONCAT(PROD_GD3,' ',PROD_GD4,' ~ ',PROD_GD5) AS prod_gd, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_STRT,120) AS ilbo_strt, CONVERT(VARCHAR(16),ILBO_END,120) AS ilbo_end, dbo.func_prod_spec_msg(prod_si1) AS prod_si1_msg, PRODUCT.PROD_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN CORP ON PRODUCT.CORP_CODE = CORP.CORP_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN FACILITY ON WORKILBO.FAC_CODE = FACILITY.FAC_CODE LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PROD_CODE, MAX(wstd_gj11) AS WSTD_GJ11, MAX(wstd_gj12) AS WSTD_GJ12, MAX(wstd_gj13) AS WSTD_GJ13, MAX(wstd_gj14) AS WSTD_GJ14, MAX(wstd_gj16) AS WSTD_GJ16, MAX(wstd_gj17) AS WSTD_GJ17, MAX(wstd_gj21) AS WSTD_GJ21, MAX(wstd_gj22) AS WSTD_GJ22, MAX(wstd_gj23) AS WSTD_GJ23, MAX(wstd_gj24) AS WSTD_GJ24, MAX(wstd_gj32) AS WSTD_GJ32, MAX(wstd_gj33) AS WSTD_GJ33, MAX(wstd_gj34) AS WSTD_GJ34, MAX(wstd_gj42) AS WSTD_GJ42 FROM WORKSTD ilbo_pg4 AS ilbo_pg4_si, ilbo_pg5 AS ilbo_pg5_si, ilbo_ck01 AS ilbo_ck01_si, ilbo_ck02 AS ilbo_ck02_si, ilbo_ck03 AS ilbo_ck03_si, ilbo_ck04 AS ilbo_ck04_si, ilbo_ck05 AS ilbo_ck05_si, ilbo_okng AS ILBO_GUBN = 'A' AND CONCAT('J',FORMAT(ILBO_PC,'000000000')) = #{danch_barcode}
